title: Design and templates
previewNote: Preview with no active forms or sign-in. Changes become public only after explicit publication.
format: KNABA package v1: ZIP up to 64 KiB containing template.json and optionally LICENSE.txt. HTML, WordPress themes, scripts and external files are not supported.
rollbackNote: Switching designs does not restore an old database. New content, enquiries and accounts are preserved.
confirm: I confirm changing the published website design.
draftNote: Saving a draft does not change the public website. KnaBa Original remains available.
loaded: Templates loaded. Review the design before publishing.
failed: The action could not be confirmed.
ambiguous: The response is uncertain. Check the current state and retry the same action if needed. Other changes remain locked until this is resolved.
conflict: The state changed. Loading the current version. Review and confirm again.
unauthenticated: Sign in as an authorized owner.
denied: Only an authorized owner may manage website templates.
languageError: The language could not be loaded. Select it again.
fileError: Choose a nonempty ZIP file up to 64 KiB.
